title: ecbolium protractum
intro: Ecbolium protractum, commonly known as the "Indian Spikenard", is a flowering plant species in the family Lamiaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Ecbolium protractum include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiseptic properties, which can help to reduce inflammation, protect against cell damage, and prevent the growth of microorganisms. The bioactive constituents of Ecbolium protractum include phenolic compounds, flavonoids, and essential oils, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects.
